title: fix(plugin-detail): record path takes a stage terminal from its option's declared kind
body:
Fixes #12907
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

`record:path` now takes a stage's terminal from its option's declared lifecycle `kind` (`SelectOption.kind`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23809) instead of guessing it from spelling.

- `deriveStages` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) carries `terminal` from the option's `kind`: `won` gives `'won'`, `lost` gives `'lost'`, `open` gives no `terminal`. The mapping is one helper, `stageTerminalOfKind`, typed by the spec's `SelectOptionKind` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (by reference, no hand-copied enum). `ObjectDefFieldLike.options[]` gains `kind?: SelectOptionKind`.
- `classify` in `record-path.tsx` now has three steps: (1) the stage's explicit `terminal`; (2) the `kind` its option declares on the status field, read through the new package-internal `declaredStageKinds(def, statusField)`; (3) the `WON_TOKENS` / `LOST_TOKENS` spelling heuristic, unchanged, only for options that declare no kind.

### A1: how a declared `open` reaches `classify`

The spec's `record:path` `stages[]` row is strict: `{ value, label, terminal?: 'won' | 'lost' }`. It has no slot for "declared open", and the synthesized default page writes the derived stages into that row (`buildDefaultHighlights`). So an absent `terminal` cannot tell "declared open" apart from "nothing declared", and a stage-borne marker would make the synthesized node fail the strict parse. The minimal change is step (2). `classify` looks up the option's declared kind by stage value in the record context's `objectSchema`, the same definition the #11106 derivation already reads, and a declared kind returns before the heuristic runs. A declared `open` therefore returns "no terminal" and the heuristic never sees the spelling. The lookup is by value, so it also covers the synthesized node's stages and authored stages that omit `terminal`. An explicit authored `terminal` still wins. When no `objectSchema` is bound, a declared `open` has nowhere to be read from and the heuristic applies as before. The synthesized node's `won` / `lost` still render without it, because they travel on the stage as `terminal`.

### Kanban measurement

`packages/plugin-kanban/src` has no spelling classifier for terminal lanes. `git grep -nE "WON_TOKENS|LOST_TOKENS|closed_won|成交" -- 'packages/*/src/**' ':!*test*'` finds no kanban hit. The positive control in the same grep is `record-path.tsx`'s own token lines. A wider grep of the kanban source for `won|lost|terminal` (non-test) finds only one comment, "won the race against its own fetch". So no kanban change was made and nothing was filed.


## Published surface (for the contract reviewer)

`@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s entry (`src/index.tsx`) re-exports `deriveStages` and the type `ObjectDefFieldLike`, and this PR adds one optional member to each:
- `deriveStages(...)` returns rows that may now carry `terminal?: 'won' | 'lost'`, taken from the option's declared `kind`.
- `ObjectDefFieldLike.options[]` may now carry `kind?: SelectOptionKind`, typed by reference to `@objectstack/spec/data`.

Both are additive and optional, so a caller that ignores them sees today's behaviour. `stageTerminalOfKind` and `declaredStageKinds` are module exports for `record-path.tsx` only and are not re-exported from the entry. Semver: `minor` (this repo levels a Clause-② widening at least `minor`); the changeset follows in the next commit. This section and line 2 were written by the seat after review; the claim comment on the card was amended in place to match.
## Tests

New `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.declaredKind-12907.test.tsx`, mounted as a JSON document through the real `SchemaRenderer`:

- (a) The card's loan (`borrowed` 借出 open / `returned` 已还 won / `overdue` 逾期 lost) draws 借出 → 已还 as the forward path with 已还 the `won` terminus, and 逾期 in the separated group, on both rows. Covered twice: through the renderer's own derivation, and through the synthesized default page node with no object definition bound. The second asserts the node's `stages` carry `terminal`.
- (b) `closed_lost` / `closed_won` declared `open` stay middle steps, with no separated group, and the declared `won` option is the terminus. Covered both for the authored node and for the synthesized node.
- (c) CONTROL: the loan without kinds has no terminals, as today, and `closed_won` / `closed_lost` without kinds are classified by spelling, as today.

Plus `deriveStages` / `declaredStageKinds` unit rows in `synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts`.

### Ablations (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with blob-hash restore)

1. Dropped the kind mapping in `deriveStages` (`const terminal = stageTerminalOfKind(o.kind);` replaced by `undefined`). Mutation landed with blob `e3fb48c34d08` changing to `03648a5aebdb`. Result: **2 failed**, the `deriveStages` unit row and (a)'s synthesized-node row. Restore: blob equals HEAD (`e3fb48c34d08`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Observed direction, reported as found: (a)'s renderer-derived row stays green under this ablation, because step (2) of `classify` reads the same declared kind off the bound definition. That row has two sources, and each of the two ablations removes only one of them.
2. Dropped step (2) in `classify`. Mutation landed with blob `1e16779cb367` changing to `0894232b3276`. Result: **both (b) rows failed**, 2 failed and 4 passed. Restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
